_source: Your_Personal_AI_Engine_(2).pptx — 13 image-only slides, Gemini Notebook export. Titles and themes transcribed by reading the slide pictures; the file has no text layer.

slides.title: Jobs and AI: Science Fiction or Fact?
slides.theme: title / framing: moving from passive observation of foundation models to actively building personal operating systems

slides.title: The Plumber's Hedge
slides.theme: escaping to the manual trades won't save you from AI; what actually will

slides.title: We are distracted by the raw horsepower of the generic engine
slides.theme: the great misdirection (bar exam / Model T), the enterprise trap (elite engineers 10% faster), the reality (doesn't restructure the economy)

slides.title: Technology drives progress when the velvet rope of specialized expertise drops
slides.theme: printing press, automobile, AI: cost and barriers fall, wild experimentation rises; easy to dismiss a technology in its clunky luxury phase

slides.title: The real economic shift happens when you harness generic power to build your specific brain
slides.theme: generic intelligence is a commodity engine; the future belongs to those who build their own engine

slides.title: Building your Personal AI Operating System
slides.theme: five gears: relative expert, taste & judgment, context engineering, iteration speed, building Jarvis; cloned output

slides.title: You do not need a computer science degree to become the relative expert
slides.theme: localized impact radius (desk, coworkers, department); mechanism / application / result / move; a 3-hour task becomes 20 minutes; share the ROI, become the default choice

slides.title: As AI generates infinite volume, human taste becomes the ultimate bottleneck
slides.theme: the danger: predictable algorithmic vocabulary, emails as a running joke; the solution: the signature, personal library, taste corrections

slides.title: Prompt engineering patches dumb models; context engineering builds the future
slides.theme: amnesia (starts from scratch, only the public internet) vs the new intern (walled workspace with past emails, transcripts, SOPs); persistent onboarding

slides.title: The proprietary value lies in your unique business context, not the foundation model
slides.theme: diagnostic comparison: baseline knowledge, economic value, competitive moat — generic model vs the personal OS

slides.title: The truly indispensable professional knows when not to use generative AI
slides.theme: risk & complexity matrix: the vending machine (deterministic scripts) vs the slot machine (deep reasoning agents, hallucinates, needs oversight)

slides.title: A personalized AI workflow effectively clones your professional output
slides.theme: one professional with curated taste + engineered context + vending-machine automations = the output of a 5-person team; scaled, indispensable node

slides.title: Closing: you do not need to quit your job
slides.theme: no CS degree needed; look at your desk, find the most tedious workflow, start building; drop the velvet rope on your own expertise
